Cpp_clock: steady_clock origin set on main entry, after paid wrapper creation
receipt_order: close data, compute hash, stamp processElapsedSeconds, close receipt
supervisor_clock: record observation seconds relative to started marker; wrapper_wall_seconds is the matching observed window
paid_upper: effective_available_seconds + T_produce - wrapper_wall_seconds, capped at producer close
journal_receipt_availability_lower: original C++ precommit timestamp; not native find time
earliest_any_saved_fleet_lower: unknown, conservatively zero; other full-witness emitters may precede the first qualifying receipt
endpoint_only: producer-close upper bound; no backdated verifier clock
